title: Briefs: Retreat ceremony timing changed
description: Amritsar: The timing for the Retreat ceremony at the Attari-Wagah joint check-post on the Indo-Pak border has been rescheduled in view of changing weather conditions. Now, the 30-minute ceremony in which border guards of both India and Pakistan jointly lower their national flags at the check-post will commence at 4.30 pm. Visitors will have to reach the venue about 30 minutes in advance along with their identity cards, preferably Aadhaar cards.
